dispute_letter.subject: Request to review water account for September 2026
dispute_letter.text:
To: Accounts Department, Karoo Bay Metro
Date: 2026-11-04

Account number: 1004 7781 02
Account holder: T. Demo
Service address: 7 Placeholder Lane, Karoo Bay
Invoice number: KBM-762511
Billing period: 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30

Subject: Request to review water account for September 2026

Dear Accounts Department,

I have checked my water bill for September 2026 against the published tariff and found the points set out below.

1. The total billed for this period is R875.15, while the published tariff gives R740.60 for 18.0 kl. The 'Water 6-15 kl' portion was charged at R38.00/kl instead of the tariff rate of R25.00/kl, which is R342.00 billed versus R225.00. (Evidence: receipts rcpt-1, rcpt-2, rcpt-3, rcpt-4)

2. The meter readings for 31 August 2026 and 30 September 2026 are both estimated, so the charge for this period is not based on an actual reading. (Evidence: receipts rcpt-1, rcpt-2)

3. The billed use of 18.0 kl is close to the normal average of 18.0 kl from previous bills, even though 9 of the 30 days in this period had no supply according to the outage log. Normal daily use over the 21 supplied days implies about 12.6 kl. (Evidence: receipts rcpt-1, rcpt-2, rcpt-3, rcpt-4)

I would be grateful if you could review the points listed above and correct the account if you agree with them. I would also appreciate a written response.

Kind regards,
T. Demo
